description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.
